name: Dakishimete Goshujin-sama!
original_name: 抱きしめてゴ主人サマッ！
source:
Erotic adventure with a maid with animal ears and tail!

The protagonist, Ritsu, is an adventurer in a world of the magic and the sword.
He was spending hard days, however, he got a company by saving a half-animal girl, Konoha.

Then he receives a letter from his father which says:
"Send me the result of this year"

Ritsu had nothing to report, so he decides to ask Konoha something...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047739.html]DLsite English[/url]]
